name: ga4gh-phenopackets skill
summary: Structurally validate a GA4GH Phenopacket v2 document (a schema for sharing clinical phenotype and disease data linked to genomic findings)
description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Phenopacket v2, shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-phenopackets` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Structurally validate a GA4GH Phenopacket v2 document (a schema for sharing clinical phenotype and disease data linked to genomic findings). Use when the user provides a phenopacket JSON document and asks whether it is well-formed, or asks which phenotypic-data sections (phenotypic features, diseases, interpretations, measurements, biosamples, medical actions) it populates.
